info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Airline Flights Refunds-v1-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Refunds API enables users to access information regarding refunds for airline flights. This endpoint allows consumers, such as travel agencies and customer support systems, to retrieve details about eligible refunds based on various criteria. Integrating this API facilitates efficient claims handling and enhances customer service by providing up-to-date refund information. Developers can leverage this functionality to create applications that help users manage flight refunds effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details regarding flight refunds, providing necessary information about the refund process for travelers seeking reimbursement.

requestBody.description: This request is used to initiate a refund process for a flight. The body must contain the necessary details to process the refund, adhering to the defined schema.
